analysis.overall: You spent 78% of the day in range, but faced a roller coaster afternoon with a steep peak above 240 mg/dL followed by a few extended low dips in the evening and morning.

events.title: Post-lunch high
events.description: Glucose reached 247 mg/dL following lunch, prompting several small correction doses that took about two hours to bring levels down.

events.title: Early evening dip
events.description: Stacked correction doses from earlier pulled glucose down to a low of 54 mg/dL before climbing back into range.

events.title: Dinner dose
events.description: A 40g carb dinner was well-managed with a 2.4u bolus, keeping glucose in a stable target zone through the night.

events.title: Morning low drift
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 59 mg/dL in the early morning and hovered low for nearly an hour before rising.

events.title: Late morning meal
events.description: Starting from a low baseline, a 70g carb meal with 4.2u insulin sent glucose climbing rapidly back toward 180 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful of stacking multiple small correction boluses close together, as they contributed to sharp dips later in the afternoon.
